The '''''Gladiator II''-class Star Destroyer''' was the second sub-class of the [[Gladiator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Gladiator''-class]] line of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was preceded by the [[Gladiator I-class Star Destroyer|''Gladiator I''-class Star Destroyer]].

==Behind the scenes==
According to Star Wars: Armada cards the Gladiator II has better anti-starfighter capabilities than the Gladiator I, furthermore the guns have increased ranges.
